sections.Profile:
Strikes N' Spares is a 1995 bowling game Premier Technology built under the Gottlieb name. Two flippers send an oversized ball down the lane at a mechanical set of ten pins, and two dot-matrix displays keep score frame by frame. Players pick from three games (Regulation, Flash and Strike 90), and operators could also set it up as a ticket redemption game. Premier made 750.
